cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a correction to your wedding programme. 'Thanks to the buffet' should name the person who cooked it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then printing my name will be a small effort. 'Buffet' describes the service, not the chef.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I will say my surname once. Please repeat that version into the microphone.
